<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the molecular ion is at m/z 114.068 Da, which matches the monoisotopic mass of the formula C₆H₁₀O₂. This formula has a double‑bond equivalent of 2, consistent with a carbonyl (C=O) and one C=C double bond. A simple structure that fits these constraints is 2‑hexenoic acid (a six‑carbon carboxylic acid with one double bond). Its SMILES representation is **O=C(O)C=CCCC**. This SMILES is valid and corresponds to the inferred formula and unsaturation.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(O)C=CCCC</final_answer>
